title: How Does Health Insurance Affect Firm Employment and Performance? Evidence from Obamacare (title from package README; batch metadata empty)
authors: Heitor Almeida; Ruidi Huang; Ping Liu; Yuhai Xuan (from package README)
package_mismatch_note: Batch row has no title/authors and the DOI is absent from candidates.csv and the OpenAlex frame, so the package-to-DOI link could not be cross-checked; the package README names the Obamacare paper by Almeida, Huang, Liu and Xuan.
eligible_reason: Single-date continuous-intensity DiD, not staggered binary. after = 1 for plan years ending on or after 23 March 2010 (ACA enactment; code/_2_final_cleaning_main.do line 57; 31 March 2010 in _4_analysis_T2.do) for every firm, interacted with w_treattotal = covered participants / 2009 employment (continuous, line 136-138) or a 10-K text measure (w_treatsentence). Every main column adds lagged employment and lagged firm controls, control x after interactions (int_*), a firm-specific pre-trend in the outcome (w_trend2_*), and industry x year FE; premium regressions use firm FE with linear and quadratic year trends instead of year FE. Fails single date, continuous treatment, time-varying controls and trend rules. Package ships pseudo (randomly generated) data only.
design_notes: SAS (_1_prepare_main.sas) then Stata reghdfe (_2 to _5 do-files); firm-year panel from Form 5500, NETS, Compustat, WRDS SEC Analytics and Kaiser survey; FE year, gvkey, industry_year; cluster gvkey. Logs from the original data are in log_files_real_data/.
data_files_note: README_Obamacare_AHLX.pdf: 'the data sets used in this replication package must be synthetic (i.e., randomly generated)'; every input is listed as 'Pseudo data ... Randomly generated' with randomly assigned company identifiers; results will not match the paper.
software_notes: SAS for data preparation, Stata for analysis.
screener_notes: Screened from package README and code (no article text or OpenAlex record found for this DOI). Single 2010 ACA date with continuous exposure; synthetic data.
